crossRefs.note: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

people.name: Haran
people.line: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.

people.name: Terah
people.line: Abraham's father who settled in Haran

translations.web: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
translations.bsb: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Haran.
translations.kjv: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
translations.asv: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
